fieldNotes.truckGate: Single main truck entrance off SW Kirklawn Ave on the north side. The plant perimeter is chain-link fenced throughout (confirmed in multiple 2024 Street View captures). The entrance is a wide divided/curving driveway with lane markings; a sliding gate is likely (consistent with the fenced perimeter) though it was open in the imagery. Marked true at medium confidence and flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth is visible at the truck entrance in clear 2024 Street View or z20-z21 satellite - the entrance off Kirklawn Ave is a wide open driveway with no checkpoint structure at the property line. Marked false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - there IS a controlled fenced entrance but NO guard booth, implying kiosk / call-box / app check-in. Flagged.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved aprons and trailer yards between the entrance and the dock banks - ample inside holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide curving entrance driveway plus expansive internal paved yard - holds well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron with significant unused paved width and lane markings - room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance off SW Kirklawn Ave serves both in and out.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from the wide divided/curving driveway - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock banks on multiple building faces with many trailers backed in - total estimated ~55, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very extensive trailer drop yards - paved rows on the NE and a large gravel overflow lot on the SW - hundreds of trailers, far exceeding 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically distinct building faces (NE/N face and SE face) indicating separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Topeka metro industrial area, adjacent to a highway interchange and other industrial development - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus character: the main plant mass plus a separate NW office building and a separate W-side warehouse building - multiple building clusters on one property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identifiable - low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - a rail line and spur run along the SE/E side of the property, serving the plant.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box yields ~105 acres covering the plant building, office, warehouse, and drop yards.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~300 trailers counted across the NE paved yard, SW gravel yard, and dock faces - approximate.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Overhead estimate; dock faces partially obscured by backed-in trailers - moderate confidence.
